name: confluence
label: Confluence
description: Team wiki for pages, blog posts, comments and spaces.

password.label: API token
password.description: API token for basic auth. Please refer to this guide to get your api credentials: https://support.atlassian.com/atlassian-account/docs/manage-api-tokens-for-your-atlassian-account

getPageContent.label: Get Page with Descendants
getPageContent.description: Gets a page's content and, optionally, all its descendants.

pageId.label: Page ID
pageId.description: Get this from the page URL of your Confluence Cloud

includeDescendants.label: Include Descendants?
includeDescendants.description: If checked, will fetch all child pages recursively.

maxDepth.label: Maximum Depth
maxDepth.description: Maximum depth of child pages to fetch.

get-page-by-url.label: Get Page by URL
get-page-by-url.description: Fetches a page by its Confluence web URL (extracts the page ID automatically).

url.label: Page URL
url.description: Paste any Confluence page URL, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DOCS/pages/12345/My+Page

search-pages.label: Search Content with Expanded Fields
search-pages.description: Search Confluence content with CQL (Confluence Query Language). Example: `type = "page" AND space = "DOCS" AND title ~ "release"`.

expand.label: Expand
expand.description: Comma-separated list of properties to expand (e.g. `body.storage,version,space,history`).

create-page-from-template.label: Create Page from Template
create-page-from-template.description: Creates a new page from a template with the given title and variables.

publish-draft.label: Publish Draft
publish-draft.description: Publishes a draft page (changes status from draft to current).

pageId.label: Draft Page ID
pageId.description: ID of the draft page to publish.

reply-to-comment.label: Reply to Comment
reply-to-comment.description: Replies to an existing footer comment on a page.

parentCommentId.label: Parent Comment ID
parentCommentId.description: The ID of the comment to reply to.

find-user.label: Find User
find-user.description: Looks up Confluence users by name, email, or keyword.

keyword.label: Keyword
keyword.description: Username, email, or display name to search for.

find-user.afterResponse:
var users = (response.results ?? []).map((result) => result.user);
return {found: users.length > 0, count: users.length, results: users};

confluence_create_page.description: Creates a page in a space.

spaceId.label: Space ID
spaceId.description: Numeric space ID (not the space key), from List Spaces or Get Space.

title.description: Page title. Must be unique within the space for published pages.

body.label: Body
body.description:
Content in the selected body format. Storage format is Confluence XHTML, e.g. "

Hello

".

bodyFormat.description: Format of Body. Defaults to storage (XHTML).

confluence_delete_page.label: Delete Page
confluence_delete_page.description: Moves a page to the trash, or purges it.

pageId.label: Page ID
pageId.description: Numeric page ID, from List Pages, Search Content or the page URL.

purge.label: Purge
purge.description: Permanently delete a page that is already in the trash. Cannot be undone.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Delete the unpublished draft of the page.

confluence_delete_page.beforeRequest:
for (const key in request.query) if (request.query[key] === 'false') delete request.query[key];
return request;
